<pre>public static final class <span class="typeNameLabel">IsolineOptions.Calculation</span>
extends java.lang.Object</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Specifies isoline parameters.
 Setting at least one limit to <a href="#rangeValues"><code>rangeValues</code></a> is mandatory or the calculation will fail.</div>
</li>
</ul>

</a>
<h3>Field Detail</h3>
<a id="rangeType">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>rangeType</h4>
<pre>@NonNull
public&nbsp;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-isolinerangetype" title="enum in com.here.sdk.routing">IsolineRangeType</a> rangeType</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Specifies the range of values to be included in the isoline.</div>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="rangeValues">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>rangeValues</h4>
<pre>@NonNull
public&nbsp;java.util.List&lt;java.lang.Integer&gt; rangeValues</pre>
<div class="block"><p>A list of ranges. The unit is defined by the type parameter.
 Each range defines the maximum allowed value to reach a destination.
 For each value an <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-isoline" title="class in com.here.sdk.routing"><code>Isoline</code></a> is calculated indicating the reachable area.
 If empty, <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-isolineoptions" title="class in com.here.sdk.routing"><code>IsolineOptions</code></a> object is considered invalid.</div>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="isolineCalculationMode">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>isolineCalculationMode</h4>
<pre>@NonNull
public&nbsp;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-isolinecalculationmode" title="enum in com.here.sdk.routing">IsolineCalculationMode</a> isolineCalculationMode</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Specifies how isoline calculation is optimized.
 The default waypoint type is <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-isolinecalculationmode#BALANCED"><code>IsolineCalculationMode.BALANCED</code></a>.</div>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="maxPoints">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>maxPoints</h4>
<pre>@Nullable
public&nbsp;java.lang.Integer maxPoints</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Limits the number of points in the resulting isoline polygon. If the
 isoline consists of multiple polygons, the sum of points from all
 polygons is considered. Note that this parameter does not affect the calculation,
 but the shape of the polygon. Look at <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-isolinecalculationmode" title="enum in com.here.sdk.routing"><code>IsolineCalculationMode</code></a> parameter
 to optimize performance.
 A higher value will result in a more accurate polygon shape. Rendering a polygon
 with a high number of points can negatively impact rendering performance.
 The minimum allowed value is 30, lower values will be ignored.</div>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="isolineDirection">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockListLast">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>isolineDirection</h4>
<pre>@NonNull
public&nbsp;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-routeplacedirection" title="enum in com.here.sdk.routing">RoutePlaceDirection</a> isolineDirection</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Specifies if calculations will be from or to a specific point.
 The default isoline direction is <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-routeplacedirection#DEPARTURE"><code>RoutePlaceDirection.DEPARTURE</code></a>.</div>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</section>
